Inspect the cut pieces

Separate pieces, not a nesting result. Scroll or zoom to inspect labels. FreeSewing previews show M and all materials. Red arrows show grain.

Downloaded and converted

  • GarmentCodeData: 251,722,049-byte patterns-only archive. Sample: 300 JSON specs, 8,715,725 bytes. 299 converted; one invalid offset rejected. Ten jobs and three previews in git.
  • Open+Pattern PT windbreaker: 539,921-byte ZIP; full six-size DXF outside git. The M subset is 509,410 bytes and keeps 35 blocks and INSERTs.
  • Numerical geometry tests and Rust contract parsing pass. Product workspace tests pass; Clippy has one existing core warning.

Limits for benchmarking

  • GarmentCode grain is assumed local panel up; this sample is one reference-body batch. Its 10 mm allowance is uniform. Mirror provenance to ETH v2 is not byte-verified.
  • Titan and Bella are blocks. Simon's optional undercollar trim is not applied; two source cutlist corrections and three grain assumptions are recorded.
  • Simon M totals 1.578 m². At an assumed 85% efficiency this is 1.237 m of 1.5 m cloth, below the rough 1.6–1.8 m consumption reference. No achieved efficiency is claimed.
  • No published commercial-CAD result with matching openly licensed vector geometry was found. Gerber/Lectra paper results are recorded as leads in SOURCES.md.
